exodus.28.p1.b1.text: “Next, have your brother Aaron brought to you from among the Israelites, along with his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, to serve Me as priests.

exodus.28.p1.b2.text: You are to instruct all the skilled craftsmen, whom I have filled with a spirit of wisdom, to make garments for Aaron’s consecration …

exodus.28.p1.b3.text: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash …

exodus.28.p1.b4.text: Make holy garments for your brother Aaron, to give him glory and splendor.

exodus.28.p2.b5.text: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.

exodus.28.p2.b6.text: Take two onyx stones and engrave on them the names of the sons of Israel:

exodus.28.p2.b7.text: … Aaron is to bear their names on his two shoulders as a memorial before the LORD.

exodus.28.p3.b8.text: You are also to make a breastpiece of judgment with the same workmanship as the ephod … And mount on it a setting of gemstones, four rows of stones …

exodus.28.p3.b9.text: The twelve stones are to correspond to the names of the sons of Israel, each engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.

exodus.28.p3.b10.text: Whenever Aaron enters the Holy Place, he shall bear the names of the sons of Israel over his heart on the breastpiece of judgment, as a continual reminder before the LORD.

exodus.28.p4.b11.text: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth,

exodus.28.p4.b12.text: alternating the gold bells and pomegranates around the lower hem of the robe.

exodus.28.p4.b13.text: … its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the LORD, so that he will not die.

exodus.28.p5.b14.text: You are to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD.

exodus.28.p5.b15.text: Make tunics, sashes, and headbands for Aaron’s sons, to give them glory and splendor.

exodus.28.p5.b16.text: After you put these garments on your brother Aaron and his sons, anoint them, ordain them, and consecrate them so that they may serve Me as priests.
